title: Chad Vanguard is gloating, draft a devastating reply

messages.content: chad posted 'space is hard 🚀' total gloat move. need killer reply with engineering but knife hidden in the math. and make it HR-safe haha or dahlia will riot.

A sharp reply that blends engineering insight with a subtle counter should do the trick. Consider this: "Indeed, achieving stable orbital insertion while accounting for the perturbative forces of microgravity requires intricate calculations. We’re forging ahead at SpaceY, where our Leviathan's precision-controlled nozzle adjustments ensure maximal efficiency. But you know how it is, Chad — when you can't overcome the gravity of your own limitations, space must seem especially hard. 🚀😏" This should communicate both the technical competence of SpaceY and a playful dig, while staying within HR's good graces.
